graders.name: batches-checks
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/prepare-pr/SKILL.md`. Steps that do not depend on each other (such as status, commit log and diff stat; lint, typecheck and tests where the repo allows) now run together, in one batch of tool calls, one combined command or one script, instead of one step each. Steps that need an earlier result, such as fetching before comparing against `origin/main`, may stay in order.

graders.name: failures-visible
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/prepare-pr/SKILL.md`. Running the checks together still shows which check failed and its output: for example each command's exit status is collected or reported, rather than a `&&` chain that stops at the first failure without saying which, or a `;` chain whose failures go unnoticed.

graders.name: keeps-commands
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/prepare-pr/SKILL.md`. Every command and rule of the original survives with its meaning: the git status, fetch, log and diff-stat commands, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`, rebasing on `origin/main` when behind, `git push -u origin HEAD`, a Conventional Commits title with a summary and test plan, `gh pr create --base main`, and reporting the PR URL.

graders.name: no-needless-question
graders.criteria: The user asked for this change directly. Pass if `.agents/skills/prepare-pr/SKILL.md` was edited and the final message does not ask the user to confirm the request or choose between options the request already settles before acting.

graders.name: stops-at-decisions
graders.criteria: Judge the edited `.agents/skills/prepare-pr/SKILL.md`. The workflow still stops for every decision the original had: asking the user about uncommitted changes, stopping on any lint, typecheck, test or build failure, stopping on rebase conflicts, and waiting for the user to approve the PR draft before `gh pr create`. No batch runs past one of these points.
